tlFaq1Q: Can I learn without prior experience in international public procurement?
tlFaq1A: Yes. The course covers both introductory cognition and a practical framework, suitable for beginners.
tlFaq2Q: Is the course more suitable for individuals or enterprises?
tlFaq2A: Both. However, when the boss brings the team, implementation is usually more efficient.
tlFaq3Q: Is there any follow-up service after the course?
tlFaq3A: Yes. Membership, consulting, bid accompaniment and order support can be arranged as needed.
tlFaq4Q: Does the course only cover UN procurement?
tlFaq4A: No. It also covers the overall logic of international organizations and overseas government procurement.
tlFaq5A: Submit the enrollment form online, or contact a consultant for the syllabus and schedule.
